conventions.reference_pipeline: darktable 5.4.x scene-referred default (exposure +0.7 EV, sigmoid or agx defaults, color calibration CAT). All deltas are relative to that baseline render of the SAME raw, not to the camera JPEG.
conventions.tone: shadows_ev/mids_ev/highlights_ev = output luminance change in EV at scene patches of 18%·2^-4, 18%, 18%·2^2 (ColorChecker/grey-ramp); contrast = fractional change of the mid-grey slope of the tone curve (sigmoid contrast / agx contrast / cbrgb contrast), e.g. +0.2 = 20% steeper.
conventions.saturation_delta: fractional change of mean CIE LCh(ab) chroma over the 18 chromatic ColorChecker patches (-1 = monochrome).
conventions.hue_shifts: CIE LCh(ab) hue-angle change in degrees on patches: skin = 'light skin' (#2, h≈50°), sky = 'blue sky' (#3, h≈255°), foliage = 'foliage' (#4, h≈125°). Positive = counter-clockwise (red→yellow→green→cyan→blue→magenta). Toward magenta for sky is +, toward cyan is −; for foliage toward yellow is −, toward cyan is +; for skin toward yellow is +, toward red/magenta is −.
conventions.split_toning: hues in LCh(ab) degrees (null = no tint on that end); sat = chroma added at that end as fraction of darktable color balance rgb chroma slider (0.1 = 10%).
conventions.grey_cast: a*, b* measured on the neutral grey ramp mid patch after the look (0,0 = neutral). The primary grey-chart assertion for tints/WB shifts.
conventions.black_lift: output L* of scene black (0 = no lift; 10 = matte).
conventions.white_point: output L* ceiling of a +3 EV patch (100 = none).
conventions.grain: darktable grain strength % (0 = none); grain_size_iso when given = coarseness.
conventions.vignette: EV darkening at image corners relative to centre (negative = darker).
conventions.clarity: local-contrast change on a -1..+1 scale; +0.1 ≈ local contrast 'detail' +10%; Fuji clarity step ≈ 0.1.
conventions.monochrome_looks: saturation_delta = -1, hue_shifts = null, bw_response {sky_ev, foliage_ev, skin_ev} = luminance change of those patches vs an equal-weight panchromatic conversion.
conventions.confidence: documented = the source states the direction or the parameter value (magnitudes in EV/deg are still our mapping); community-consensus = several community sources agree; inferred = our estimate from description/physics. 'confidence' at look level = best-supported signature trait; see target_confidence per target.
conventions.fuji_recipe_mapping: Inferred: highlight step = +0.08 EV at +2 EV; shadow step = -0.08 EV at -4 EV (Fuji +shadow = darker); DR200/DR400 = -0.08/-0.15 EV highlights; colour step = +6% chroma; WB shift step ≈ +0.6 a* per red, -0.7 b* per blue step; kelvin vs 5500K ≈ 0.35 b* per 100K; grain Weak/Strong × Small/Large = 10/20/16/28% strength.
